{{Infobox lan |name=Spring cup 1999 |tickername=Spring cup 1999 |image= |icon= |organizer=AMD clan |admin={{Player|Green|flag=ru}} |sponsor= |type=Offline |country=Russia |city=Moscow |venue= |tournaments=4on4 |prizepool=Fame and glory |date= |year=1999 |entrance= |website= |twitch= |twitch2= |youtube= |teamfirst= |teamsecond= |teamthird= |teamthird2= |map1=dm3 |map2=e1m2 |team_number=42 }} The championship was held in the spring of 1999 in Moscow in several computer clubs - AstalaVISta, Nirvana.

The unofficial name was invented by one of the participants of the championship (RDY-Mutabor) - "Open teamplay tournament among clans mainly of the hero city of Moscow in teams 4 on 4 in the computer game Quake1 on maps of the team's choice according to the rules of full double elimination with the final, without the participation of teams that took the first 3 places in MGL-1". Official name - "Spring cup '99".

The tournament was held on a very strange system with double elimination (a team was eliminated from the tournament after two losses). Before each round there was a draw, after which there were three clans in the groups that played with each other.
